cap:info.cap:headline: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. High wave warning for the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coast. Significant wave heights of 3.0 to 3.5 metres expected.
cap:info.cap:description: EXERCISE. Strengthening south-westerly monsoon flow over the north Bay of Bengal is expected to raise significant wave heights to 3.0 to 3.5 metres off the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coast from late morning. This is a rehearsal bulletin issued for a demonstration and describes no real forecast.
cap:info.cap:instruction: EXERCISE. Fishermen are advised not to venture into the sea along this stretch. Small craft operations should be suspended.

cap:parameter.cap:value: Drill bulletin authored for SagarDrishti. Not issued by INCOIS.
